sourcesContent: /* Archive Button Styles */ .btn-archive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: #f59e0b; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .btn-archive:hover { background-color: #f59e0b; color: white; transform: scale(1.1); } .btn-archive i { font-size: 1.125rem; }
